# BuyGenix Solutions

> BuyGenix Solutions (buygenixsolutions.com) is an Indian B2B platform based in New Delhi. It connects Indian exporters and suppliers with live buyer requirements from importers and bulk buyers in India and abroad, helps overseas buyers source from verified Indian suppliers, and handles export registrations and compliance (IEC, GST, APEDA, Spices Board, FSSAI, RCMC and more).

Buyer contact details are shared only with paying members. Overseas and domestic buyers can post their requirements free.

## For exporters and suppliers
- [Buyers & importers by category](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/buyers): live buyer requirements by category, sub-category and product
- [Search buy leads](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/buy-lead-search): search buyer requirements by product
- [Membership plans](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/membership): plans with yearly buyer lead credits, business listing and promotion
- [Services](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/services): buyer leads, digital catalogue, SEO and registrations
- [Export registrations](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/registration): IEC, GST, APEDA, FSSAI, RCMC, Spices Board and other registrations

## For buyers sourcing from India
- [Post a requirement](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/#post-requirement): free, the team connects buyers with suitable Indian suppliers
- [Supplier directory](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/search?type=companies): Indian suppliers and their products
- [How to import from India to the UK](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/import-from-india-to-uk-trade-compliance-guide): CETA duty, VAT and documents

- [Duty Drawback scheme](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/duty-drawback-scheme-guide): AIR vs Brand Rate and how to claim

- [RoDTEP vs Duty Drawback vs EPCG](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/export-incentive-schemes-rodtep-duty-drawback-epcg)
- [India-UK FTA (CETA) for exporters](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/india-uk-free-trade-agreement-exporters-guide)
- [ISF 10+2 filing for USA shipments](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/isf-10-plus-2-filing-guide-usa-shipments)
- [All guides](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/blog)
